question: What is the strangest way you have ever made money?
story: I got paid four hundred dollars a month to pretend I was my neighbor's son. Mrs. Alvarez lived alone across the hall and had exactly one rule. Every Sunday at two, I sat in her kitchen, ate her cooking, and called her Mom on speakerphone with her sister in Ohio. That was the whole job. Her sister had spent thirty years bragging about her perfect family, and Mrs. Alvarez was tired of losing. So she invented me. I had a fake job, a fake degree, and a fake dog named Pepper. For two years I was the greatest son that woman never had. Then her sister announced a surprise visit and I panicked. Mrs. Alvarez did not. She handed me a photo album she had been secretly building the entire time, full of pictures of me she had taken without me noticing. The visit went perfectly. She stopped paying me a long time ago. I still call every Sunday.
